issue_request: FHIR-13999 was a Published/Persuasive STU3 pharmacy change request saying valueset-medication-request-intent had order and instance-order as siblings and should instead make instance-order a child of order, matching request-intent.
initial_application: No FHIR-13999-tagged commit was found. The MedicationRequest-specific intent CodeSystem was introduced in git 7373e742ee with order-related concepts still at the top level. Later git 886f421a86, applying FHIR-34218, added an order hierarchy but nested instance-order below filler-order.
additional_context: The current build uses MedicationRequest as the successor to MedicationPrescription, and source/fhir.ini lists medicationrequest as active. FHIR-34218 clarified MedicationRequest instance-order MAR usage and requested an order hierarchy, but did not require instance-order to be filler-specific. The later Published FHIR-20499 workflow decision moved generic Request.intent instance-order out from under filler-order to a direct child of order because instance orders may be created by placing as well as filling systems. No Zulip or Confluence evidence was found that conflicts with this conclusion.
reconciliation: Updated source/medicationrequest/codesystem-medicationrequest-intent.xml so instance-order is a sibling of filler-order inside the order concept. The MedicationRequest intent ValueSet already includes the complete CodeSystem, so no ValueSet compose change was needed.
